No liveness deadline is enforced.

Action ordering: per the sampling contract, push and flush in a row are applied before that row's pre is observed, so a same-row push may already appear as a valid FIFO head and a same-row flush removes entries before the head check.

Fixture contract (not an upstream timing guarantee): the requirement that a READB entry's RX bytes are all delivered by the time it pops is a property of this fixture's pop/RX ordering; the upstream docs only give byte/command causality.

patches.before: "assumption": "ready is pop after processing, not acceptance",
patches.after: "assumption": "ready is pop after processing, not acceptance; same-row push/flush applied before pre; READB pop after RX delivery is a fixture ordering contract, not an upstream timing guarantee",

rationale: Push/flush actions are now applied before observing pre, matching the public sampling contract (action applied while clock low, pre settled before edge); previously a same-row pushed head was flagged as an empty-queue fifo_head failure and a same-row flush left stale entries. Selftests now exercise real same-row head validity (pass and wrong-head fail) and same-row flush (pending without head failure, stale head fails), closing the masking gap. Property checks are unchanged in strength; pending/clean event semantics unchanged. Contract and P7 document the ordering and identify pop-after-RX as a fixture contract.
